iti97:2.1: Kalyāṇasīlo bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇadhammo kalyāṇapañño imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso ti vuccati.
iti97:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
iti97:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇasīlo hoti.
iti97:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sattannaṃ bodhipakkhikānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogam-anuyutto viharati,
iti97:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇadhammo hoti.
iti97:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññāya sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
iti97:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇapañño hoti.
iti97:6.1: Iti kalyāṇasīlo kalyāṇadhammo kalyāṇapañño imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso ti vuccatīti.
